purpose: R1 protocol rebuilt for the public corpus (development step L, ruling R-2). The original private protocol.json is not in this repository; this one follows development step D, 'R1 method'.
corpus: ~/cerebrollm-corpus (research/corpus/manifest.json); indexed with engine/cerebrollm.toml into the live table; the chunk snapshot is exported from that table
sampling: random.Random(27).sample(eligible chunks, len(eligible)) over rows ordered by node_id; the first 150 chunks that yield a valid question are used (a chunk with no valid question after five attempts is skipped and recorded)

question_generation.helper: sources/llama-embedding-qa.py generate_qa_embedding_pairs (LlamaIndex 0.10.68; the old name generate_question_context_pairs)
question_generation.prompt: as in study.py selection() and r1_selection.py PROMPT, with up to four rewrite variants on rejection

qwen_query_prefix:
Instruct: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query
Query:

scoring.node_id: LlamaIndex RetrieverEvaluator (hit_rate, mrr) with expected_ids=[sampled node id]; the fixed R1 rule uses this scoring
scoring.text_identity: a retrieved chunk whose text sha256 equals the sampled chunk's text sha256 counts, whatever its id; reported alongside (ruling R-2)

rule: highest hybrid hit@5 (node-id scoring), then hybrid MRR@10, then chunks/min; indexing must finish in under 60 minutes
embedding_pacing: research/model-study/embed_pace.py caps embed calls at 25 texts/s (Windows ephemeral-port limit); backoff seconds are excluded from index time
